Before you decide

Use these questions when comparing vehicles or talking with a retailer.

  • Request an itemized, dated quote showing applicable taxes and fees.
  • Verify current rules with the Canada Revenue Agency.
  • Confirm whether the figures in a past video still apply to your purchase.

Canada & U.S. context: This video uses the market named in its title. Canadian equipment, prices and availability may differ from U.S. offerings. This companion page does not publish a current price quote.

Editorial context

The available catalogue information does not specify payment, vehicle loan or filming-access arrangements for this video. The relationship is unconfirmed here. This page adds no driving claim, numerical score or test result.
